brief:
The user mostly prefers dramas, especially when strong writing makes the story and characters engaging and explores the human condition.

They loved Her for exploring how people can still end up alone despite technological convenience and relative prosperity in a not-too-distant future. They consider that theme valuable and worth examining.

They disliked every film in the 50 Shades series, calling the material terrible and saying it should not have been approved as either books or movies. They were disappointed that the series earned so much money, expressing criticism of at least American audiences. They did not specify particular writing flaws or scenes.

They also liked The Incredibles. Discussing the appeal of superhero movies, they emphasized visual effects and sound design and their fascination with what visual artists and animators create. They enjoy imagining themselves as a superhero, though they qualified that they usually do not get too carried away with it.
